source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DO200, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « The top performance D/A chip ES9068AS from ESS Technology; »; « XMOS XU-216, true 32bit audio processing, supports DoP and Native DSD, and reaches 32bit/768kHz and DSD512; »; « All inputs support DSD streaming, including coaxial and optical (DoP64); »; « Qualcomm's latest Bluetooth chip supports APTX/HD, SBC, AAC; »

facts.chip: ESS ES9068AS (« The top performance D/A chip ES9068AS from ESS Technology »), XMOS XU-216 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
